[Verse 1]
[Bb5]In the darkness swallowed
into the night
Trapped in the clutches of my
[Ab5][Gb5][F5][Eb5]indecision
[Bb5]Falling further past the
point of control
So desperate to cast a-
[Eb5]way [F5]this [Ab5][Gb5]feeling

[Pre-Chorus]
[Bb5]
[Ab5]Cry out for rescue
[Bb5]Cry out for relief and
[Ab5]give me peace There
[Bb5]must be a way to
[Ab5]stifle this decay There
[Bb5]must be a means,
[Ab5]means to an end

[Chorus]
[Gb5]When the fear and panic
[Ab5]takes a hold
[Bb5]You must take control
[Ab5]
[Gb5]When your sorrow drags you
[Ab5]down below

[Intrelude]
[Bb5]Take con-
[Ab5]trol
[Bb5]
[Ab5](Take control)

[Verse 2]
[Bb5]No more wallowing
[Ab5]Battle my constraints
[Bb5]I'm the sinner
[Ab5]and the saint
[Bb5]

[Chorus]
[Gb5]When the fear and panic
[Ab5]takes a hold
[Bb5]Look within your soul
[Ab5]
[Gb5]When your sorrow drags you
[Ab5]down below
[Bb5]You must take control
[Ab5]
[Gb5]Your strength will unfold
[Ab5]Take con-

[Bridge 1]
[Bb5]trol

[Bridge 2]
[Bb5]
I must find a way
So my
words can penetrate
[Gb5]And I
[Ab5]pray that you understand

pain someday)
